facts.text: Everyone eats or nobody does. Your move, little one. Make it a good one.
facts.why: Not a line from the film that I could find. Dementus's real lines found include 'Today, we dance to Darwin' and 'Lady and gentlemens, start your engines!'. A note is allowed, but this one invents a speech and a pet name.
facts.fix: Pull up a bucket. Gastown feeds whoever is still standing.
